probes.name: footerless code commit is REFUSED at commit-msg
probes.command: echo a > src/a.ts && git add -A && git commit -qm a
probes.evidence:
refused: no 'task: <id>' footer in the message's final trailer block
  rule: a commit that introduces files carries a task footer in the trailer block — a 'task:' line mid-body does not bind

probes.name: a new commit citing a done task is REFUSED
probes.command: mkdir -p src && echo b > src/b.ts && git add -A && git commit -qm b -m 'task: d'
probes.evidence:
refused: task 'd' is done — a finished task authorizes only its own paperwork, not new code
  rule: a footer binds what the commit introduces to a task in flight and its declared scope

probes.name: an editor-composed message (git's comment block after the footer) binds
probes.command: mkdir -p src && echo c > src/c.ts && git add -A && GIT_EDITOR=/tmp/claude-1000/-home-excelsior-Desktop-stallion/339ea17b-541d-4652-8df5-1841c43957ed/scratchpad/fprobes/ed.sh git commit -q

probes.name: resurrecting a done task by editing its record is REFUSED
probes.command: echo '{"id":"d","phase":"executing","riskClass":"tooling","scope":["src"],"pins":[],"history":[]}' > .tasks/d.json && git add -A && git commit -qm undo -m 'task: d'
probes.evidence:
refused: .tasks/d.json moves its phase backwards (done → executing)
  rule: a task record's phase only moves forward and its scope is frozen after planned — task-state writes records, an editor does not

probes.name: pushing a branch outside HEAD's history is REFUSED
probes.evidence:
refused: this push carries ref(s) outside the checked-out history: refs/heads/evil
  rule: the push fence judges HEAD's history — a pushed tip HEAD cannot reach would land unjudged

probes.name: a clean merge (git pull) needs no footer, and the push lands
probes.command: git merge -q --no-ff --no-edit side && git push -q origin main
probes.evidence: task-coverage: doctor clean (hooksPath, hook gate lines, registry, adoption base)

probes.name: a merge keeping a stale side's copy over a fix is REFUSED
probes.command: git merge -q --no-ff --no-commit side; git checkout side -- lib/x.ts && git commit -qm merge -m 'task: t'
probes.evidence:
refused: code outside 't' declared scope:
    lib/x.ts

probes.name: a merge forged with an ancestor parent (a rollback) is REFUSED by the CI range check
probes.command: C=$(git commit-tree $(git rev-parse HEAD~2^{tree}) -p HEAD -p HEAD~2 -m forged -m 'task: t') && git update-ref refs/heads/main $C && node tools/task-coverage.mjs --base origin/main
probes.evidence:
refused: 1 problem(s) in the commits this range brings
  3a6a1eb5 (task t): code outside 't' declared scope:

probes.name: the first push of a new branch is judged, and lands
probes.command: git checkout -qb feat && echo f > src/f.ts && git add -A && git commit -qm f -m 'task: t' && git push -q -u origin feat
probes.evidence: task-coverage: doctor clean (hooksPath, hook gate lines, registry, adoption base)

probes.evidence:
doctor: wiring incomplete
  .githooks/pre-commit is not '#!/bin/sh' opening with its gate line(s), exactly:

reviews: independent adversarial round 1 (~30 probes): 3 blockers (merge stale-copy/forged-parent rollback, PR CI on the synthetic merge commit, self-vouching task records) + 7 majors (fence judged by the pushed code, base re-pin, CI new-branch done-law, force-push base, one bad remote commit blocking every push, registry swallow forms, shebang) — all fixed except the pushed-code ceiling, documented (protect the default branch, review fence surface)

independent adversarial round 2: every round-1 fix held incl. everyday flows (pull merge, pull --rebase, revert -e, cherry-pick -x, squash, conflict merge, rebase) and the real-repo clone; 4 majors (done-then-code in one push, a merge undoing done, CI force-push fallback anchor, battery emptied) + minors — fixed and pinned by live self-tests
